item.title: 🟠 Critical SharePoint RCE CVE-2026-50522 Under Active Exploitation After Public PoC
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
A third SharePoint Server flaw patched by Microsoft as part of its Patch Tuesday update for July 2026 has come under active exploitation, per watchTowr. The vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-50522 (CVSS score: 9.8), a critical deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint that could allow an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
